paginas.contenido:
Unit 4 focuses on planning for the future, whether it's scheduled maintenance, long-term projects, or predictions.
  • RA1 & RA2: Reading technical plans and timelines.
  • RA3: Discussing future plans in professional meetings.
  • RA4: Writing technical proposals and schedules.
  • Grammar Goals: Mastering Future Perfect, Future Continuous, and connectors.

💡 Nota: El futuro perfecto es esencial para prometer plazos a clientes o jefes.

Used for actions that will be in progress at a specific time in the future.

Structure:

Subject + Will be + Verb-ing

Examples:

  • "We will be testing the new software all next week."
  • "This time tomorrow, I will be presenting the project plan."
  • "The team will be working on additional features while we test."

💡 Nota: Lo usamos para dar una idea de continuidad en el futuro.

Used for actions that will have finished before a certain point in the future.

Structure:

Subject + Will have + Past Participle

Examples:

  • "By the end of this month, we will have completed the update."
  • "He will have finished the report by the time the meeting starts."
  • "By tomorrow, the IT department will have resolved all issues."

💡 Nota: Solemos usarlo con la preposición 'By' (para antes de).

Connectors help you link ideas and create complex sentences.
  • Although: (Aunque) - Used for contrast. "Although it was outdated, they kept the server."
  • While: (Mientras) - For simultaneous actions. "Testing while the team works."
  • Because / So: (Porque / Así que) - For cause and effect.
  • Despite: (A pesar de) - Followed by a noun or -ing. "Despite the issues, we finished."

paginas.titulo: Future Plans: 'Going to' vs Present Continuous
paginas.contenido:
How to express different types of future plans.
  • Going to: Intentions or plans not yet fully organized. "I am going to study for the CCNA."
  • Present Continuous: Fixed arrangements (date and time set). "We are meeting with the developers next Monday."

Essential terms for the preparation phase of IT projects.
  • Diagnostic Test: A procedure to identify the nature of a system problem.
  • Project Plan: A document outlining the scope, goals, and steps of a project.
  • Timeline: A graphical representation of a period of time.
  • Deadline: The final date for completion.

Review these core concepts for Unit 4.
  • Future Continuous: Progress in future ("Will be testing").
  • Future Perfect: Finished before a deadline ("Will have completed").
  • Connectors: Use 'Although' for contrast and 'Despite' for hurdles.
  • Plans: Use Present Continuous for confirmed meetings ("Are meeting").
Complete this test to confirm you have mastered the Unit 4 content.

preguntas_test.q: By the end of this month, we __________ (complete) the system update.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Acción que habrá terminado para un momento futuro = Future Perfect.

preguntas_test.q: They decided to upgrade the system __________ it was outdated.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'Although it is raining, I will go out.'

preguntas_test.q: We __________ (meet) with the developers next Monday.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Plan organizado con fecha específica = Present Continuous.

preguntas_test.q: He __________ (finish) the report by the time the meeting starts.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Terminará antes de otro evento futuro = Future Perfect.

preguntas_test.q: We __________ (test) the new software all week, __________ the development team works on features.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Futuro continuo para duración y 'while' para simultaneidad.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'I will be sleeping while you work.'

preguntas_test.q: By tomorrow, the IT department __________ (resolve) all the network issues.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Estructura estándar de Future Perfect con 'By tomorrow'.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'I will have resolved the ticket by then.'

preguntas_test.q: The technician __________ (fix) the issue by tomorrow, __________ there are no unexpected problems.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Future perfect combined with 'despite' (a pesar de).
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'He will have fixed it despite the heat.'

preguntas_test.q: They __________ (test) the new system later today.
We ran a diagnostic test __________ found several issues.
preguntas_test.explicacion: 'And' une acciones que siguen una secuencia lógica.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'I checked the log and saw the error.'

preguntas_test.q: She __________ (present) the new project plan in the meeting.
